$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: The class: knight, archer, sorcerer or thief.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "Thief" (docs and debug tools).

notes.description: The class fantasy and where its data comes from.

pitch.description: The class card pitch on the new-game screen (mw-e19.5), until descKey text lands.

verbs.description: The three signature verbs the class card lists, e.g. "Parry" (mw-e19.5).

nameKey.description: Localisation key of the display name; absent = "class.<id>.name".

descKey.description: Localisation key of the class card pitch; absent = "class.<id>.desc".

dialogueTag.description: Tag on class-gated dialogue options, shown as e.g. [Thief] (mw-e22.6). Unique per class.

iconId.description: Class emblem asset id (style bible §15.1); a placeholder until the art lands.

portraitId.description: Class card illustration asset id (style bible §15.1).

items.description: Capability id declared in src/content/data/capability/, e.g. "spell.mage-hand".

startingCapabilities.description: Capabilities granted at new game, with the permanent class source (ADR-0004).

items.description: Capability id declared in src/content/data/capability/, e.g. "spell.mage-hand".

signature.description: Capabilities that define the class and are never shared (ADR-0004 "simple" rule).

count.description: How many the player starts with.

equip.description: Starts equipped in its slot (a single unit of an equippable item).

startingKit.description: What the player starts with (grey-box; tuned during m2/m3).

proficiencies.description: Proficiency tags the class has, matching items’ equip.proficiencies, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor", "shields". Soft (mw-e17.4).

armorCapacityKg.description: Equipped armor weight at 100% load (ADR-0003: knight 30, others 23). Kilograms.

health.description: Starting health (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap.

stamina.description: Starting stamina (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap.

mana.description: Starting mana (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap.

stats.description: Start values of the supporting stats.

unlockChannels.description: Progression channels that apply, the primary one first (ADR-0004).
